method: Matched configs/seeds; genuine Astra 12 km / 14 layers and Sol 28 km. Raw 8-neighbour active echoes, no dilation/bridges. Fixed 6--9 h window; connected-component statistics are not a persistent storm identity.
changes: parcel pressure work separated from contact fraction
coherent head normals, resolved pressure slope retained
bounded nearest warm donor within two cells; no crossing ridges or increasing cold-pressure peaks
ambient head resistance without additional shear-direction flank penalty
not_changed: signed environmental shear and actual inflow gates
CAPE debt and shared donor budgets
rain microphysics and conservative surface accumulation
default grids, levels, duration and UI controls
limits: No guarantee all seeds remain connected; terrain/sea/dry inflow may genuinely split a line.
Two seed 10-hour checks, not default 6-km/72-hour validation.
12-km lookup is up to 24 km; Sol 28-km up to 56 km as an unresolved-head closure, not resolved kilometre-scale plumes.
